instruction: With LibreOffice Calc running, use the terminal to filter the open ODS file on the desktop to include only entries where Age is between 30 and 40 (inclusive), then export the filtered data to a CSV file named file_example_ODS_5000.csv.

metadata.explanation: Task requires filtering the ODS file to include only entries where Age is between 30-40 (inclusive), then exporting to CSV using terminal commands. Evaluator checks if all rows in the output CSV have ages within the 30-40 range. Gives full credit (1.0) if all rows match the age criteria, partial credit proportional to the ratio of matching rows.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both instruction requirements: (1) filtering ODS file to age range 30-40, and (2) exporting to CSV file
Getter logic is correct: reads CSV file from correct path (/home/user/Desktop/file_example_ODS_5000.csv) and returns all rows as list of lists
Metric logic is correct: finds Age column, checks all data rows are within [30, 40] range (inclusive), handles edge cases (missing Age column, non-numeric values, empty data)
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric directly accesses expected.get('min_age') and expected.get('max_age') without incorrectly accessing expected.get('rules')
Expected values are semantically correct: min_age=30 and max_age=40 match the instruction requirements exactly
Complete coverage: evaluator checks both that CSV file exists and contains only filtered rows
Postconfig is appropriate: kills terminal after task completion to ensure clean evaluation state
Edge cases handled correctly: empty CSV returns 0.0, missing Age column returns 0.0, non-numeric ages are skipped
Data flow is semantically correct: CSV file -> getter extracts rows -> metric validates age range against expected rules
